attributes.description: SRE dashboard for OVH billing data. Tracks spend per invoice, cost breakdown by service/description, AI Endpoints usage, cloud credit consumption, and account health from logs-ovh_billing.bill-* and logs-ovh_billing.account-*.

embeddableConfig.content:
## OVH Billing — Cost & Account Overview
Monitors **billing line items** (`ovh_billing.bill`) and **account details** (`ovh_billing.account`) ingested from the OVH cloud provider. Use the controls above to filter by Bill ID, domain, or description.

query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE ovh.billing.bill_detail.currency_code == "EUR"
| STATS `Total spend` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE ovh.billing.bill_detail.currency_code == "EUR"
| STATS `Total spend` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| STATS `Distinct Invoices` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ovh.billing.bill_detail.bill_id)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| STATS `Distinct Invoices` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ovh.billing.bill_detail.bill_id)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| STATS `Total Billing Line Items` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| STATS `Total Billing Line Items` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price < 0
| STATS `Total cloud credit applied` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price < 0

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Total Spend` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Month` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Total Spend` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Month` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE (@timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend)
  AND (ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Gateway*" 
    OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Floating IP*"
    OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Loadbalancer*"
    OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Octavia*")
| STATS `Total Spend` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Description` = ovh.billing.bill_detail.description
| SORT `Time Bucket`

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE (@timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend)
  AND (ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Gateway*" 
    OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Floating IP*"
    OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Loadbalancer*"
    OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Octavia*")
| STATS `Total Spend` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Description` = ovh.billing.bill_detail.description
| SORT `Time Bucket`
